Name: Ladder Locator
Author: ChaosEnergy
Description:
This mod will mark the stones which will spawn a ladder or shaft to a lower level. If you can't see any marking it simply means you have bad luck and no stone will generate a ladder or shaft. Just clear some stones until the RNG is in your favor and the marks will eventually appear.

[list]
[*]Mark stones hiding ladders/shafts with several highlighting options (see config file for options)
[*]Force shafts to appear rather than ladders in the Skull mines (toggle with tilde)
[*]Show a list of ores found on the current level (toggle with ctrl+shift+tilde)
[/list]
[size=5]Install[/size]

Easiest way is to use the mod manager, these are the manual steps if you prefer:

[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[*]Supports [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
[/list]

[/size][list]
[*][url=https://github.com/yuri-moens/LadderLocator]Source code[/url]
[/list]
